Our record performance in 2022 is a testament to our resilience and commitment to Asia. We are proud to be named World's Best Bank by Global Finance.
I just published a breakdown of Mr. Piyush Gupta's remuneration. It includes salary, cash bonuses, and deferred components. What are your thoughts on these figures?
While the bank celebrates $8 billion in profit, my home loan interest rates keep climbing. Is this where our money is going? To fund a $15m salary?
Record profits should mean better benefits for all employees, not just the top 1%. Our low-wage workers are struggling with 6% inflation while the CEO gets a 13% raise.
From an investment perspective, Gupta has delivered exceptional value. DBS is the only SG company in the Top 100 Best Workplaces for Innovators. Talent comes at a price.
Grateful for the team's hard work in a challenging year marked by high inflation and bearish markets. We continue to focus on sustainability and innovation.
DBS Foundation has committed S$5.6 million to financial literacy and food waste. We are building a more inclusive society.
Wait, the foundation gets $5.6m for the whole of Asia, but one man gets $15.38m for himself? The optics of this are terrible.
